lineage.external_freeze_rule: Actual canary or matrix custody additionally requires every declared bundle file to equal git show HEAD:path; a later external freeze must pin a pushed commit.

trusted: semantic_manifest.json and pipeline_contract.json as data-only declarations
every regular nonlink transitive source hash-bound by semantic_manifest.json
explicit_nonblocking_residuals: arbitrary in-process Python callers invoking private helpers

surface.simulator_evidence_override: PW_R9_SIMULATOR_EVIDENCE_ROOT is a hidden synthetic simulate/reopen-only containment seam and does not authorize actual calls.

semantic_pipeline.cell_gate: Before each attempt, reopen every exact same-slot required PASS completion and required stage artifact and bind the sorted kind/id/path/hash/bytes rows into attempt.json.
semantic_pipeline.finalizer: After a PASS completion, create every newly eligible same-slot artifact as canonical expected_artifact payload plus one LF, verify its declared payload and storage identities, then reopen it.
semantic_pipeline.fail_stop: A complete TASK_COMPLETE result with deterministic subject mismatch is durably completed as FAIL and makes all later same-slot rows ineligible; no later same-slot attempt is admitted.
semantic_pipeline.invalid_stop: Any transport, dependency, mutation, custody, identity, or evidence INVALID aborts all slots.

backend_interface.transport_admission: Result must be request-bound, terminal=true, terminal_status=TASK_COMPLETE, task_complete observed and turn-bound, and child_reaped=true.
backend_interface.subject_failure_boundary: A transport-admitted result is deterministically scored; exact rc0 response mismatch is permanent subject FAIL, not controller INVALID.
backend_interface.provider_input_rule: provider_input.txt is exact manifest render UTF-8 with one terminal LF; provider_input_utf8 is exactly those bytes minus only that LF.

verifier_interface.clean_rule: A full clean matrix requires exactly 291 PASS completions and 54 valid route-local stage artifacts.

run_custody.bundle_binding: Sorted successor-root-relative path/sha256/bytes rows for operating contract, controller, backend, verifier, semantic and pipeline data, routes, schedule, architecture and static contracts/catalogs.
run_custody.actual: GIT_HEAD_PINNED with every bundle byte equal to git show HEAD:path

evidence_contract.root: evidence/<run_id>/ or the simulator-only selected root
evidence_contract.durability: All evidence is regular nonlink, create-only, fsynced, and reopened; JSON is canonical plus one LF except provider_input.txt.
evidence_contract.permanent_invalid_rule: Any admitted attempt without a valid completion, mutation, malformed dependency or transport, illegal post-FAIL advance, inconsistent chain, unexplained missing row, or missing eligible stage artifact permanently invalidates the run; there is no resume path.

schedule.ordering: slot-major: manifest route order outer, selected manifest schedule order inner
schedule.stop: SIGINT or SIGTERM sets a request flag; an admitted foreground invoke drains through raw capture, validation, completion seal, reopen, and eligible artifact finalization, then no new attempt is admitted before stopped terminal accounting.

nonclaims: This internal iteration is not a formal candidate, audit, freeze, canary result, qualification run, readiness claim, or empirical evidence.
Development simulations have zero qualification credit.
Static checks and synthetic output cannot prove provider behavior, production enforcement, host integrity, pushed-commit custody, or qualification.
